To infer (from circumstance); जात्या व्यक्तिराक्षिप्यते K.
To pass (as time); याचिनस्तु न च कालमाक्षिपत् Śi.14.45.

आक्षिप्तिका [ākṣiptikā], A particular air or song sung by a character while approaching the stage; [चञ्चत्पुटादितालेन मार्गत्रयविभूषिता । आक्षिप्तिका स्वरपदग्रथिता कथिता बुधैः (भरतनाट्य- शास्त्र)]; प्रावेशिकी आक्षिप्तिका
आक्षेपः [ākṣēpḥ], 1 Throwing off, tossing, pulling off, snatching away; अंशुकाक्षेपविलज्जितानाम्
Reviling, censure, blame, abuse, reproach, defiant censure;
Applying, laying on, putting in or into (as a colour); गोरोचनाक्षेपनितान्तगौरैः
Hinting at, reference to, taking to oneself or assuming as the meaning of another word; स्वसिद्धये पराक्षेपः K.

(In Rhet.) A figure of speech (cf. Greek paralipsis) in which something really intended to be said is apparently suppressed or denied to convey a particular meaning; आक्षेपः स्वयमुक्तस्य प्रतिषेधो विचारणात् । चन्द्रसंदर्शयात्मानमथवास्ति प्रियामुखम् ॥ Kuval. For fuller definitions and explanations see K.
. -Comp. -रूपकम् A simile in which the object compared is only hinted at; Kāv.
Drawing or snatching up; इमामाक्षेपिणीं सिद्धिमातनोमि शिवाय वः
Drawing in with a minute eye; बाह्याभ्यन्तरविषयाक्षेपी चतुर्थः Pat. Sūt.
आक्ष्यत् [ākṣyat], a. (fr. अश् or अक्ष्) Leading to completion (as days), epithet of certain days on which the ceremony Ayana performed for the Ādityas and Aṅgirasas is finished.
